input: # Documents as alchemy/render.alc writes them, and the trees they read
# back as. Atom requires an id, a title and an updated of a feed and of
# each entry, dates in RFC 3339 form, and an author of a feed unless
# every entry has one, and the render writes what the tree lacks by the
# conventions the loss list in tabnas.plugin.json states: the id
# tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render, an entry's with a slash and its
# position after it, an empty title of type text, the updated
# 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, a date in RFC 822 form as the same instant in
# RFC 3339 form and one in neither form as that updated with a category
# of the scheme tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render/date keeping its text,
# and an author named by the feed's title with the render's id as its uri.
# Every runtime reads them back as written.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <title type="text">News</title>
  <id>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render</id>
  <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  <author>
    <name>News</name>
    <uri>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render</uri>
  </author>
  <entry>
    <summary type="html">First</summary>
    <id>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render/0</id>
    <title type="text"></title>
    <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title type="text">Second</title>
    <id>http://example.org/2</id>
    <link href="http://example.org/2" rel="alternate"/>
    <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
  </entry>
</feed>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <title type="text">Dates</title>
  <updated>2003-06-10T04:00:00Z</updated>
  <id>tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render</id>
  <entry>
    <title type="text">One</title>
    <published>2003-06-10T09:41:01-05:00</published>
    <updated>2003-06-10T09:41:01-05:00</updated>
    <id>urn:one</id>
    <author>
      <name>A</name>
      <email>a@example.org</email>
    </author>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title type="text">Two</title>
    <published>2003-06-10T04:00:00+01:00</published>
    <updated>2003-06-10T04:00:00+01:00</updated>
    <id>urn:two</id>
    <author>
      <name>b@example.org</name>
      <email>b@example.org</email>
    </author>
  </entry>
  <entry>
    <title type="text">Three</title>
    <published>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</published>
    <category term="published" scheme="tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render/date" label="sometime last week"/>
    <updated>1970-01-01T00:00:00Z</updated>
    <category term="updated" scheme="tag:tabnas.dev,2026:feed-render/date" label="sometime last week"/>
    <id>urn:three</id>
    <author>
      <name>c@example.org</name>
      <email>c@example.org</email>
    </author>
  </entry>
</feed>
